commit.message:
8396627: [macos27] java/awt/dnd/InterJVMGetDropSuccessTest/InterJVMGetDropSuccessTest.java test fails

The test was interrupted before new and pretty drop rejection animation is finished. In order to
increase only the drop wait timeout the new method awaitDropFinished() is added. Since this method
reads the finished value both reading and assigning of this value are moved under the Util.SYNC_LOCK
to avoid thread race. The timeout for drop wait is set to 5 seconds. That can potentially increase
time of the test execution by 4 seconds which is reasonable meaning the overall test duration.
